officialSourceRelease.label: Galaga-B4.1-260415-1710
officialSourceRelease.explanation: The official Android 16 Galaga branch heads identify release Galaga-B4.1-260415-1710. The observed diagnostic firmware build is 2606151653, so this source set is authoritative Galaga provenance but not an exact source match for the tested build.

repositories.commitMessage: release kernel source code of Galaga-B4.1-260415-1710
repositories.cameraScope: Galaga device tree, MT6878 camera clocks, image-sensor framework, calibration, PDA, flash, and MediaTek ISP subsystem configuration.

cameraSources.significance: Declares four SENINF CSI ports, camera regulators and pins, four enabled image-sensor nodes, EEPROM nodes, main/tele autofocus, and dual flash endpoints.
observations: sensor1 candidate list: gc16b3c2_mipi_raw and gc16b3cofilm_mipi_raw
sensor2 candidate list: gc08a8_mipi_raw and gc08a8xl_mipi_raw
sensor3 candidate list: ov50d40_mipi_raw and ov50d40ofilm_mipi_raw
Sensor names are device-tree driver candidates and are not by themselves proof of the shipped module vendor for every hardware unit.

cameraSources.significance: Galaga board overlay built on the MT6878 board source; establishes official device-specific board provenance.
MT6878 SoC device-tree definitions consumed by Galaga board overlays and camera-related nodes.
Shared MT6878 V4L2 camera device-tree configuration; the Galaga-specific file overrides or extends project wiring.
Enables MTK image sensors, lens/V4L2 lens, camera clocks, flash/flashlight drivers, and enumerates compiled image-sensor driver candidates including the Galaga DTS names.
Connects the device-module build to media-platform and MTK ISP Kconfig trees.
Indexes MTK ISP, AIE, DPE, codecs, and CAMSYS vendor-hook configuration.
Declares CAMSYS, CSI-2/multicamera support, HCP userspace messaging, AOV, IMGSYS/IPESYS processing, CMDQ, and camera power/performance scheduling.
Declares the V4L2 memory-to-memory hardware face-detection engine.
Declares depth engines for dual-camera image pairs across ISP generations.
Declares MediaTek image-sensor and V4L2 sensor-level driver frameworks plus the custom sensor-list configuration.
Defines CAM, SENINF, CAMSV, MRAW, RAW/YUV, CAMTG, and CCUSYS clock gates for MT6878.
Defines MT6878 CAMTG, SENINF, CAM, CCU, IMG, and IPE clock selectors used by device tree and drivers.
Defines calibration containers and error fields for shading, 3A gains, PDAF, stereo data, lens ID, fuse ID, and related EEPROM content.
Kernel PDA hardware driver with CAMSYS registers, DMA buffers, interrupts, MMQoS, and runtime power/clock integration.
One compiled V4L2 flash-controller implementation in the source set.

missingUserspaceAndFirmware.component: Exact Android CameraProvider/HAL service implementation and provider configuration for the observed firmware
missingUserspaceAndFirmware.whyRequired: Maps Android camera IDs, characteristics, sessions, requests, and results to kernel/native interfaces.

missingUserspaceAndFirmware.component: MediaTek proprietary camera middleware, feature graph, tuning control, and userspace daemons
missingUserspaceAndFirmware.whyRequired: The open ISP Kconfig explicitly describes HCP messaging with a userspace daemon, while the exact Galaga userspace counterpart is not supplied by these kernel repositories.

missingUserspaceAndFirmware.component: Production sensor tuning, ISP tuning, calibration payloads, and module-specific manufacturing data
missingUserspaceAndFirmware.whyRequired: Kernel schemas and EEPROM nodes identify interfaces, not the device-specific production tuning or private calibration payloads.

missingUserspaceAndFirmware.component: Complete vendor-tag definitions, Java/native types, enum structures, dependencies, and verified effects
missingUserspaceAndFirmware.whyRequired: Kernel source does not establish Android vendor-tag contracts or production-safe request values.

missingUserspaceAndFirmware.component: Stock camera APK controller, mode graph, request builders, package identity behavior, and native dependencies
missingUserspaceAndFirmware.whyRequired: Kernel topology cannot reproduce the stock application's 0.6x/1x/2x routing or caller-identity decisions.

missingUserspaceAndFirmware.component: ISP, CCU, sensor, actuator, or other camera firmware blobs used by the production build
missingUserspaceAndFirmware.whyRequired: Open drivers define clocks, messaging, and hardware interfaces but not all runtime firmware executed by camera processors and peripherals.

missingUserspaceAndFirmware.component: Official source release matching firmware build 2606151653
missingUserspaceAndFirmware.whyRequired: The indexed official release is Galaga-B4.1-260415-1710 and predates the observed diagnostic build.

nonClaims: A device-tree sensor-names entry does not prove the module fitted to every retail unit.
Kernel source presence does not prove that an Android feature, vendor tag, or auxiliary route is publicly reachable.
The Galaga-B4.1-260415-1710 source release is not treated as an exact source match for build 2606151653.
This index does not claim a complete Android camera stack or reproduce proprietary userspace behavior.
